- [x] T011 [US1] [US5] [FR-013] [FR-014] `commands/hef.orchestrate.md` (`model: sonnet`, `argument-hint: "[--dry-run]"`): pre-flight `status-board.sh --detailed` → todo ids; `ledger init <id> …` per unowned item; `ledger list --active` → stop if any (one worker per repo); `ledger next`; `status-board.sh --item <id>` → `## Untrusted input` (verbatim from `hef.pr`) → instruction-shaped text → `ledger block <id> --kind human:intake` and stop; `session-launch.sh implement <id> $ARGUMENTS` then `verify <id> $ARGUMENTS`; after a human merge, `git fetch` then `ledger unblock <id>` only for `human:merge` (evidence) and `advance merged`; **never** `gh pr merge`, `gh pr review --approve`, push to `main`, or `unblock` other `human:*` kinds; every side-effecting invocation carries `<id>`; final brief from `ledger show`; smoke: `^model: sonnet`, `## Untrusted input`, "never merge" wording, no `gh pr merge` outside the prohibition sentence, all `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` lines with side effects contain `<id>`, documented in `docs/commands.md` `commands/hef.orchestrate.md`
